resources.string: Request a reset code for your NAS account email address. If you already have a code, paste it below.

If an active NAS account uses this address, a reset code will be sent. Check your inbox and spam folder. The code expires in 15 minutes. If no email arrives, try again later or contact your NAS administrator.
Your password has been reset and all NAS sessions have been signed out. Sign in with your new password. Your records and photos are preserved.
The code is invalid, used or expired. Check the email address and code, or request a new code.
Password recovery is currently unavailable. Your NAS administrator may need to enable email recovery.
Too many recovery attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
The NAS server could not be reached or the request failed. Check your connection and try again.
